forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: ぼけていませんでした

definitions.explanation: to become senile; to have one's mental faculties decline with age
for an image or photo to be out of focus or blurred
to play dumb; to feign ignorance; to act confused (often in comedy)

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ぼけてきた。
examples.english: My grandfather has been becoming senile lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ぼけないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}おう→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Let's keep our minds active so we don't become senile even as we age.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぼけ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦パズル→パズル：05417_pazuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}いている→解く：02301_toku⟧。

⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぼけさせる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{被写体|ひしゃたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ→引き立つ：25243_hikitatsu⟧。
examples.english: Blurring the background makes the subject stand out.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピント→ピント：06363_pinto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼけて⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{撮|と}れなかった→撮る：00760_toru⟧。

examples.english: The back-and-forth between the funny man and straight man is entertaining.

notes:
ぼける is an intransitive ichidan verb with distinct meanings related to mental decline, visual blur, and comedic behavior.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive form is ぼかす (to blur, to obscure).

WRITING:
- Can be written as {惚|ぼ}ける or {呆|ぼ}ける, but hiragana is most common

SENSE 1 - SENILITY:
- Describes age-related mental decline
- ⟦ぼけ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (senility prevention) is a common phrase

SENSE 2 - PHOTOGRAPHY:
- Describes out-of-focus images
- "Bokeh" in photography terminology comes from this word
- Can be intentional (artistic blur) or unintentional (failed focus)

SENSE 3 - COMEDY:
- In ⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧ (manzai), the ⟦ぼけ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧ says absurd things while the ⟦ツッコミ→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ reacts
- Also means to feign ignorance in general conversation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ぼけ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (senility progresses)
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼける (photo is blurry)
- ⟦ぼけ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ツッコミ→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ (funny man and straight man)

REGISTER: Neutral. Sense 1 may be considered somewhat direct when referring to actual senility.
